_about: Channel config. The customer approves these domain lists; code reads them and neither the model nor the user can widen them. Every text here is fixed, never computed from today's date, so request bodies stay identical and saved runs keep matching.

nasdaq_equity.label: Nasdaq-listed equity
nasdaq_equity.market_label: Market channel: Nasdaq corporate actions alert
nasdaq_equity.issuer_query_template: Press release from {issuer} (Nasdaq: {ticker}) announcing a {event}, with the ratio, the effective date and time, the first day of split-adjusted trading, and the new CUSIP
nasdaq_equity.market_query_template: Nasdaq Equity Corporate Actions Alert for {issuer} ({ticker}) {event} and CUSIP change, with the effective date

nyse_equity.label: NYSE-listed equity
nyse_equity.market_label: Market channel: SEC filing, 8-K (issuer, legally filed)
nyse_equity.issuer_query_template: Press release from {issuer} (NYSE: {ticker}) announcing a {event}, with the ratio, the effective date and time, the first day of split-adjusted trading, and the new CUSIP
nyse_equity.market_query_template: {issuer} Form 8-K about its {event}, with the effective date and the new CUSIP

corporate_bond.label: Corporate bond
corporate_bond.issuer_label: Issuer channel: wires and the issuer's own newsroom
corporate_bond.market_label: Market channel: SEC filing (issuer, legally filed)
corporate_bond.issuer_query_template: Press release from {issuer} announcing the {event} of its notes with CUSIP {cusip}, with the redemption date and redemption price
corporate_bond.market_query_template: {issuer} SEC filing about the {event} of notes with CUSIP {cusip}

channel_kinds.market: the exchange's or the SEC's official notices

system_prompt_template: You are checking a security master exception for an investment operations team. Use only {kind} about {subject}; ignore every other company and every other security. Copy dates and times exactly as the source writes them. If a later notice updates an earlier one, use the later one. Write not stated for any field the source does not give. Never infer.
repair_query_template: {issuer} ({ticker}) {event}: effective date, ratio and new CUSIP

identifier_in_source.description: Ticker or CUSIP of the affected security, exactly as the source prints it. For a bond with no CUSIP printed, the coupon and maturity as printed

event_type.description: One of: reverse split, forward split, ticker change, name change, ADS ratio change, redemption, tender offer, other

terms.description: Split or ratio terms, or redemption price and amount, as stated

effective_as_stated.description: Effective date and time exactly as the source writes it

market_effective_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the first trading day on the new terms, or the redemption date for a bond, or not stated

new_cusip.description: New CUSIP as stated, or not stated

new_symbol.description: New ticker as stated, or not stated

source_notice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD printed on the notice itself
